revision.reason: The initial research included the upstream 2022–23 file, which had identical 2–3 scores in all 1,312 regular-season games. That file is quarantined and this report is rebuilt from valid 2023–24 and 2024–25 training seasons. The 2025–26 holdout, model settings and publication threshold are unchanged. No NHL prospective forecasts were published from the initial report.

source.name: SportsDataverse / fastRhockey NHL schedules (NHL upstream)
source.attribution: SportsDataverse / fastRhockey authors; NHL source results normalized and transformed by TONATI LAB. No endorsement.

processing.limitations: Latest revised historical files, not archived point-in-time snapshots. Scheduled start time plus 48 hours approximates final-result availability. Regular season only; official final scores include overtime and the shootout deciding goal. No starting goalie, injury, lineup, roster, rest-day, expected-goals or market-price inputs. Training uses original historical team identity; Arizona is not silently treated as Utah. Source UTA uses the current franchise name within each season; no form is carried across seasons.

featureDefinitions: Home minus away average goal margin in up to 10 prior same-season regular-season games, including overtime and shootouts
Home minus away win fraction in those same games; all final game wins count
